question: I got exactly a C in 15-112 this semester. Does this meet the prerequisite for 15-122 (Principles of Imperative Computation)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-122 requires 15-112 at least C. An exact C meets this minimum threshold; the phrase 'at least C' is inclusive of a C grade.
common_mistake: Treating 'at least C' as strictly greater than C; interpreting the boundary as exclusive
needs_verification: Confirm CMU's grading policy treats 'at least C' as inclusive of a C grade
Confirm P-003's grade in 15-112 is indeed exactly a C (not C- or D+)
Check if CMU-Q uses +/- grading and whether a C- would satisfy 'at least C'
